english.title: Obstruct / hinder a person assisting an emergency worker
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, obstructed or hindered a person by **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE OBSTRUCTION/HINDRANCE..) while

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was engaged in rendering assistance to

(C)_[a person employed by **(..SPECIFY THE FIRE AND RESCUE AUTHORITY..)]_
(D)_[a person whose duties as an employee or servant of the Crown involved extinguishing fires or protecting life and property in the event of a fire]_
(E)_[a person employed by **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT NHS BODY..) in the provision of ambulance services]_
(F)_[a person employed by **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT NHS BODY..) in the provision of air ambulance services]_
(G)_[a person providing ambulance services pursuant to arrangements made by, or at the request of **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT NHS BODY..)]_
(H)_[a person providing air ambulance services pursuant to arrangements made by, or at the request of **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT NHS BODY..)]_
(I)_[a person providing services for the transport of organs, blood, equipment or personnel pursuant to arrangements made by, or at the request of **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT NHS BODY..)]_
(J)_[a person being a member of His Majesty's Coastguard]_
(K)_[a person being a member of the crew of a vessel operated by the Royal National Lifeboat Institution]_
(L)_[a person being a member of the crew of a vessel operated by **(..SPECIFY THE OPERATOR..) for the purpose of providing a rescue service]_
(M)_[a person who was mustering the crew of a Royal National Lifeboat Institution vessel or attending to its launch or recovery]_
(N)_[a person who was mustering the crew of a vessel operated by **(..SPECIFY THE OPERATOR..) for the purpose of providing a rescue service or attending to its launch or recovery]_
(O)_[a person being a Ministry of Defence fire-fighter,]_

while that person was responding to emergency circumstances
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2 and 4 of the Emergency Workers (Obstruction) Act 2006

date and location

being a member of the crew of a vessel operated for the purpose of providing a rescue service OR

who was mustering the crew of a vessel providing a rescue service/attending to its launch/recovery

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 1(3) of the Act for an explanation of the term "Responding to emergency circumstances" .
(ii) See section 1(4) of the Act for an explanation of the term "Emergency circumstances".
(iii) See section 1(5) of the Act for an explanation of the term " Relevant NHS body".
(iv) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.

other.penalty:
Summary : A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit on prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
